heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋一列圖示卡片＋底部小圖文列
desc: 上方置中的標題組，中段一列等寬的圖示卡片（圖示在上、文字在下、皆置中），最下方置中放一張方形小圖片與一段強調文字並排。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略。標題下方是多個項目排成的網格，整體置中、約佔畫面寬度的三分之二，項目等寬、同一列等高。每個項目是一張卡片：小圖示在上、說明文字在下，兩者都水平置中。網格下方置中放一列：左側一張方形小圖片，右側一段強調文字，兩者垂直置中並排；小圖片明顯小於卡片。這一列可省略，沒有時其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：標題組維持置中在上方；網格改為每列一個項目，卡片內改為左右排列，小圖示在左、說明文字在右並靠左對齊。最下方一列的方形小圖片隱藏，強調文字置中，下方改為顯示一顆主要按鈕。

en.name: Centered heading + row of icon cards + small image-and-text row
en.desc: A centered heading group at the top, a row of equal-width icon cards in the middle (icon above, text below, both centered), and at the bottom a centered row with a small square image beside a short emphasized text.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above it; omit it when there is no content. Below the title, place multiple items arranged in a grid, centered as a whole and taking about two thirds of the viewport width; items are equal in width and items in the same row are equal in height. Each item is a card: a small icon on top and a description below, both horizontally centered. Below the grid, place a centered row: a small square image on the left and a short emphasized text on the right, side by side and vertically centered; the small image is clearly smaller than the cards. This row is optional; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Switch to a vertical stack: the heading group stays centered at the top; the grid becomes one item per row, and inside each card the layout becomes horizontal, with the small icon on the left and the description on the right, aligned left. In the bottom row, the small square image is hidden, the emphasized text is centered, and a primary button is shown below it instead.
